purpose: Durable, content-addressed policy variables that can be amended independently while preserving dependency impact, safe effective boundaries, and append-only history.

state.rule: Every state is self-digesting. A later state names its exact parent and amendment head; each ledger entry also preserves the amendment identity, authority, reason, old-state link, changed values, approval identity, and a recoverable record digest. `time_basis` distinguishes an observed UTC timestamp from the deterministic synthetic epoch used when Bootstrap must preserve repeatable plan hashes. No snapshot overwrites history. The portable kernel remains prepared and inactive until explicit owner activation.

variable_classes.CONSTITUTIONAL: Cannot be weakened by a project amendment; a governance-version change is required.
variable_classes.OWNER_MUTABLE: May be changed by an owner-authorized amendment at its declared effective boundary.
variable_classes.DERIVED: Computed from other variables and never directly amended.
variable_classes.CAMPAIGN_LOCAL: Scoped to one admitted campaign and not a durable project preference.
variable_classes.EPHEMERAL: Runtime observation only; it is not authority.

questions: Is the variable declared and owner-mutable?
Is the requested value valid and materially different?
What dependent variables, acceptance roots, agents, and proof must be recompiled?
At which safe boundary may the value become effective?
Has the exact amendment received authenticated owner approval?
change_gate.rule: A user request may be recorded at any time, but no derived controller silently changes until the amendment is content-addressed, approved, and effective.

amendment.approval_rule: A conversational confirmation, a shared link, or an unverified Markdown statement cannot apply an amendment. Application requires an exact amendment digest and authenticated owner approval.
amendment.stale_rule: An amendment whose parent policy digest is not the current state is rejected and must be rebased into a new candidate.
amendment.constitutional_rule: Acceptance roots, independent audit, no self-acceptance, internal recovery, and secret prohibition cannot be disabled through project policy.

amendment_ledger_entry.rule: The append-only ledger is inspectable without recovering an unrelated external object. Each record retains the exact requested values and approval metadata.
